stories.title: PCA's August Was Historic — Now September Decides the MVP (TIER 1 — FOLLOW UP)

x_posts.label: Post 1-1
x_posts.text: Pete Crow-Armstrong in August: 14 HR. 1.098 OPS. 27 games. He enters September at .283, 38 HR, 91 RBI, 32 SB — and the NL MVP conversation is basically over unless Ohtani proves otherwise. #Cubs #NLMVPRace

x_posts.label: Post 1-2
x_posts.text: Cubs are 78-60. PCA has 38 HR and 91 RBI. 28 games left. September decides NL MVP. No one else in the National League is even close to this kind of two-way impact right now. #Cubs #MVP

article.headline: Pete Crow-Armstrong's August Was Historic. September Decides the MVP.

stories.title: Misiorowski Tomorrow at Wrigley — The Sept 2 Start (TIER 1 — FOLLOW UP)

x_posts.label: Post 2-1
x_posts.text: Jacob Misiorowski (13-5, 1.73 ERA, 222 K, 0.755 WHIP) pitches at Wrigley tomorrow. NL Cy Young frontrunner vs the Cubs. The most anticipated start of the second half. #Brewers #CyYoung

x_posts.label: Post 2-2
x_posts.text: Misiorowski's fastball has dropped from 100.5 to 98.7 mph this season. Results haven't changed. But with 28 games left and NL Cy Young on the table, every start is a referendum. He goes tomorrow at Wrigley. #Brewers

article.headline: Misiorowski Takes the Mound at Wrigley Tomorrow. The Cy Young Race Watches.

x_posts.text: Jackson Chourio just became one of 17 players in MLB history with 20+ HR in each of his first 3 seasons. The others: Ted Williams, Eddie Mathews, Mickey Mantle, Frank Robinson, Cepeda. All in the Hall of Fame. Chourio is 22. #Brewers #MLB
